description: TypeScript source file defining classes and data structures for public event type output, including nested classes for location, source, booking fields, user profiles, owner, schedule, and the main output class for API responses.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents a location with a type property.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Represents a source with id, type, and label properties.

classes.name: OptionInput
classes.description: Defines an input option with type, required, and placeholder properties.

classes.name: BookingField
classes.description: Represents a booking field with various properties including name, type, labels, options, sources, and flags.

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: Represents an organization with id, optional slug, name, and metadata.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: User profile details including username, id, organization, and visual customization options.

classes.name: Owner
classes.description: Owner details including profile, branding, and metadata.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User details including profile, username, name, and booking URL.

classes.name: Schedule
classes.description: Schedule information with id and timezone.

classes.name: PublicEventTypeOutput
classes.description: Main data structure for public event type output, including event details, locations, booking info, owner, schedule, and related flags.

classes.name: GetEventTypePublicOutput
classes.description: API response wrapper with status and data fields for public event type output.
